entries.name: effect-reservation-never-observed
entries.claim: THE SUBJECT ABSENT ENTIRELY. Every movement insert fires the trigger the compiled target declares as `factStorage.companion.reservationTriggerName`, which copies the movement into the effect-reservation companion. That companion's PRIMARY KEY omits `business_period` and `record_id` and is the ONLY natural-effect guard in the system -- the movement's own `effectIdentityUnique` carries a freshly minted `record_id` and can never collide between two postings. The foreign key runs companion -> movement ON DELETE RESTRICT, so a movement with NO reservation row violates no constraint. Remove the read-back and a posting whose reservation never happened commits silently, leaving the 23505 raced-replay refusal unreachable for that effect. Kill is measured in the reservation test this command runs.
entries.original:
await assertMovementEffectReservations(

      );

entries.name: effect-reservation-compared-on-count-not-columns
entries.claim: A PROXY SATISFIED WHILE THE FACT DOES NOT HOLD. The reservation read-back could pass by observing that a row EXISTS for each movement while never comparing what that row reserves. This mutation leaves the row count, the one-to-one mapping and every other column comparison intact and neuters exactly one column of the five-column effect tuple. A reservation writer that reserves the WRONG natural effect then satisfies the foreign key, the primary key and the row count, and a later posting of the REAL effect finds nothing reserved and commits a duplicate. Only the column comparison catches it.

entries.name: derived-writer-inventory-registration-never-required
entries.claim: THE DERIVED INVENTORY STOPS REQUIRING A VERIFIER. The inventory is derived from the compiled storage target -- each written entity's table, its declared partitions, its declared effect-reservation companion, and any projection whose insert trigger the target declares on a table this posting writes -- and construction refuses when any derived relation carries no registered read-back. This mutation makes the unverified set permanently empty, so construction STOPS THROWING and a release whose compiled target reaches an unobserved relation is accepted. That is precisely the failure PUR-2a's nine rounds each found one more instance of: the inventory was hand-enumerated while the target already declared every writer.
